rules: terrain-seamless.png must remain the grass/dirt ground source
house collision uses HOUSE_SPECS footprint only
tree collision uses trunk rectangle only
new scenery features must be additive overlays, not replacements for protected render/collision functions

camera.rule: POV changes modify CAMERA_ZOOM only; do not rewrite terrain/collision systems.

combat_update: v11 death-state fix on top of v10 combat balance

combat_behavior.engage: click/tap selects a mob; ATTACK engages the selected mob within configured engage range
combat_behavior.auto_chase: up to 82 world pixels after a valid engage
combat_behavior.attack_button_gcd: 0.90 seconds; repeated attack presses cannot bypass combat timing
combat_behavior.first_attack_delay: 0.62 seconds; enemy wind-up begins slightly sooner to prevent free opener spam
combat_behavior.disengage: move beyond disengage range or tap LEAVE COMBAT
combat_behavior.hp_display: world-space health bars and target HUD
combat_behavior.potions: quick-use button remains available during combat

death_fix.root_cause: enemy killing blow cleared combatTarget, then updateOpenCombat dereferenced combatTarget.kind in the same frame
death_fix.fix: capture attacking mob and schedule cooldown before applying damage; return cleanly if combat clears
death_fix.respawn_cleanup: movement input, attack timers, attack animations, and combat FX reset before Oakrest respawn

architecture_update: v21 expanded starter zone on top of v20 backpack inventory
asset_layout: external organized assets under assets/; decoded embedded sprites preserve original bytes
balance_config: config/game-balance.js is cache-busted on launch and fetched network-first/no-store; balance-only edits require no build step. Starting values apply to new/reset state; existing saves retain saved player values.

targeting_update.selection: click/tap a living mob to select it without immediately entering combat
targeting_update.hud: selected mob name and exact HP/max HP remain visible in the target HUD
targeting_update.world_feedback: selected mob gets a target ring and world-space HP bar
targeting_update.attack: ATTACK prioritizes the selected mob; aggressive mobs still auto-engage normally

keybind_config: config/keybinds.js is cache-busted on launch and fetched network-first/no-store; key-only edits require no build step. v20 adds backpack I/B.

pc_controls.attack: Space or F engages the selected target; auto-combat timing remains authoritative

github_actions: .github/workflows/static.yml is the canonical Pages workflow; v16 cleanup preserved.

water_update.renderer: dedicated 512x512 seamless high-resolution water texture with subtle animated glints
water_update.shoreline: irregular grass overlap, broken sandy bank pixels, and short foam highlights
water_update.cache_hardening: runtime-loader cache-busts js/game.js; index version-busts runtime loader/style; service-worker cache v19

inventory_update.stacking: centralized addItem/removeItem API with per-item stack limits
inventory_update.catalog: config/items.js is live/cache-busted for item metadata and stack overrides
inventory_update.save: inventory persists in existing save object; legacy saves normalize to an empty backpack
inventory_update.controls: HUD backpack button plus I/B keyboard toggle

world_update.npc_placeholders: 5 town/farm NPC anchors for future vendors and quest givers
world_update.regional_spawns: slimes north-central, goblins northeast camp, wolves wilderness
